items.lede: Jensen Huang's Nvidia GTC keynote speech in Berlin was disrupted by a Greenpeace protest on Wednesday.
items.title: Jensen Huang Nvidia GTC keynote disrupted by Greenpeace protest over chips in Russian drones

items.lede: Containerized datacenters, androids, and telecoms all feature in Berlin keynote interrupted by environmental protesters
items.title: Jensen Huang sends in the robot ducks to sell Nvidia's AI-everywhere vision

items.lede: At Nvidia’s GTC in Berlin, Huang unveiled the company’s new plug-in data center—the DSX Pod—as the key to unlocking Europe’s AI infrastructure lag. Oh, and autonomous humanoid robotics.
items.title: Jensen Huang’s Vision for Europe Runs on Plug-In Data Centers
